title.narrative: Armenia HIV NFM - Armenia (01-Jan-2016-31-Mar-2019)

description.narrative: Armenia, HIV, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Armenia (MOH)This program has the following goals: Maintain low level of HIV epidemic and provide HIV treatment to all who need it. The objectives of this program are: Scale up ART to reach 90% of those in need of treatment. Scale up HIV testing to ensure 75% of PLHIV know their status
